To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the probability of call connection and the effective call duration distributions for complete calls and incomplete calls depend on the cell residence time distribution, the call holding time distribution, and the number of cells visited; and 2) the effective call duration of an incomplete call is the sum of the effective call holding and the effective cell residence times of that call.

the probability of call completions and the effective call completion times for PCS networks depend on the distributions and parameters of the call holding time distributions and the cell residence time distributions, as well as the cell residence time distribution.

the call completion probability is the same as that in a single cell with an infinite population, the effective call holding distribution is the weighted sum of the original distribution and the cell residence distribution, and the probability that a call will be completed is independent of the call holding time distribution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new models for the PCS network cost/performance analysis under general distributions of call holding time and the cell residence time.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PCS network performance and cost analysis should consider the call holding time distribution and the cell residence time distribution as two separate parameters.

, for a given cell residence time distribution, the probability of call completions and the effective holding time distributions for both complete and in-complete calls are uniquely determined by the call holding time distribution.
the classical exponential assumption on the call holding time and the cell residence time is not appropriate in the emerging PCS network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the call completion probability is not sensitive to the cell residence time distribution, but is very sensitive to the call holding time distribution, and the effective call completion probability is very sensitive to both the cell residence time and the call holding time distributions.

the call completion probability is insensitive to the cell residence time distribution and the effective call completion time distribution for complete calls can be approximated by the Erlang distribution with an appropriate shape parameter, which is independent of the cell residence time and call holding time distributions.
the probability of call connection and the effective call duration for complete calls are independent of the cell residence time distributions for all call holding time distributions considered.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PCS networks should be modeled with general distributions for call holding times and residence times.
a PCS network should be modeled with general distributions for call holding times and/or cell residence times.
